description: Validate a DM-approved prose summary (200 to 20000 characters), resolve the session number and show the price (free at Standard quality on any paid plan) without creating a session. After the user approves the summary, call chargen_create_session_log.

notes.description: DM prep notes (extraction context, not part of the summary)

recorded_at.description: When the session was played, ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for now.

session_number.description: Session number to backfill. Omit to append after the latest session.

summary.description: DM-approved prose summary of the session, 200 to 20000 characters. Name the NPCs, places and items that mattered.

name: chargen_quote_session_log
title: Quote a session log
